name: facebook-photos
description: Find a Facebook profile's own-photo grid, open its viewer, and save unique still photos.

stages.goal: Scroll the Facebook profile until the body section named Photos or Fotos is visible with several thumbnails.
stages.guidance: Ignore the top navigation tabs and feed post images. Look for the dedicated profile-body photo card, usually in the left or main column.

stages.goal: Open the full Photos grid from the visible profile-body Photos section.
stages.guidance: Prefer a link such as See all photos or Ver todas las fotos inside the body photo card. Return done if the full photos grid or a single-photo viewer is already open.

stages.goal: Activate the tab for photos belonging to the profile owner.
stages.guidance: Choose Photos of <owner> or Fotos de <owner>. Never choose tagged photos or Albums. Return done if the correct tab or a viewer is already active.

stages.goal: Open the first real photo tile and stop when the dark single-photo viewer is visible.
stages.guidance: Click near the center of the first real tile in the owner-photo grid. Avoid avatars, headers, menus, ads, and side panels. The desired viewer has a large image and often comments on the right.

collection.inspectionPrompt: Accept only when Facebook's dark single-photo viewer is open and the main visible media is a still photo. Reject profile pages, grids, feeds, videos, loading placeholders, and ambiguous overlays.
